question: PH-K1 run: the tier-1 oxidation-limit ladder of every candidate (outputs under results/preprint/pourbaix/ph_k1/).
rule: claims_redirect.md 2a/2c: E_ox = min over registered oxidation reactions; undetermined never passes; a solid-salt sink bounds the onset from above (a falsification stands, a pass is inconclusive).

gate.reaction: CaCO3 + 2 LiClO4 -> Ca(ClO4)2 + CO2 + 0.5 O2 + 2 Li

inputs.lit_params_corpus_note: lit/corpus/phosphate_coverage.yaml named in the brief does not exist on any branch; the row ids come from lit/evidence_table.csv (TR-001..TR-119) and lit/corpus/T-R/gaps.md

conventions.sink: solid-salt LiClO4 (Ca(ClO4)2 and Al(ClO4)3 through the tabulated exchange enthalpy, solid entropy of the exchange neglected and bounded); solvated sink: gap
conventions.water: H2O(l) at activity a_w on the experimental route; DFT water is H2O(g) at p = a_w x p_sat(0.0317 bar)
conventions.a_oh_reading: activity of the OH-site (HAp) component in the lattice; lowering it raises the onset
conventions.budget: linear sum of the row uncertainties (2 sigma USGS as printed; NBS rows 20 units of the last figure) plus T x the exchange entropy bound, divided by n_e F: the recipe of window_margin_expt, which it reproduces for the carbonate reaction
conventions.status_rule: below: onset < inf - m; above: onset >= sup + m and every reaction determined; undetermined: a reaction lacks data and the determined subset is not below; else within budget

dehydration_threshold.reaction: CaHPO4.2H2O -> CaHPO4 + 2 H2O (liquid at activity a_w)
dehydration_threshold.reading: the hydrate is the stable form only above a_w*; a_w* >= 1 within the row uncertainties means brushite is not stable against monetite at unit water activity (a precursor, reported not decided)

key_requests.why: a_w of the carbonate electrolyte (trace water); a_w_slurry is a slurry-only gap. Until then a_w is reported over the grid [1.0, 0.01, 0.0001, 1e-06].
activity (site fraction) of OH in a carbonated or substituted apatite; reported over the grid [1.0, 0.5, 0.1, 0.01].
gaps at this params sha: without a solvated sink every onset is a solid-salt upper bound and no phase can pass at tier 1
entropy bound of the Al + 3 LiClO4 exchange (W1's bound is for Ca(ClO4)2 only); the Al-phase budgets lack this term
Li3PO4 DfG and S (only DfH, TR-040): its experimental route is undetermined
Al(PO3)3 has no thermochemistry: AlPO4's staged reaction and Al(PO3)3 itself are undetermined
crystalline Ca(PO3)2 (only S, and the glass DfH); needed for Ca(PO3)2 and for the staged Ca2P2O7 reaction (Sandstrom 2006 EMF is paywalled)
OCP DfH and S (only DfG, TR-039): no cross-check of the OCP value and no dehydration threshold
tabulated uncertainty of the quartz formation free energy (the JANAF text prints none); silicate budgets lack this term
thresholds C5c_ox grants m_expt to the registered carbonate reaction only; the per-reaction budgets computed here by the same recipe (provisional) need registered keys

key_requests.key: tier-2 records (class A or B) for Ca phosphates
key_requests.why: none found for Ca phosphates; Li3PO4 and AlPO4 have class B sources (W2)
